verdict_reason: Tab, role filter, link-keeping and logging are correct against inc-067/068; one Major naming finding where 'type' names both the tab's address type and the role copy.

todos.issue: The word 'type' names two concepts in this controller: addressType (lines 141, 174, 179, 184, 199) is the tab's category (ORIGIN_OR_CONSIGNOR etc.), while copy.list.search.type (line 73) and copy.list.table.type (the Type column) hold copy for a role, which the same controller calls role/roles/roleItems (lines 142-161, 185). A reader of roleItemsOf sees a 'type' placeholder on a role select and cannot tell which concept 'type' means; the ticket calls the same thing a 'use'.
todos.fix: Must: one concept, one name — the role select, the role column and their copy keys share the role vocabulary, and 'type' in code means only the address type (the tab). One way: rename copy.list.search.type to copy.list.search.role and copy.list.table.type to copy.list.table.roles in copy.en.js and copy.cy.js, and update roleItemsOf and list.njk to match.
